gen-eater-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Spiky, moody, a little menacing. Eater's heading strokes carry gentle swell, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe keeps a lowercase a with no thin hairlines and oversized letters in tight, quiet rows.
gen-eater-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Eater drags its wide-spaced, brooding letters across the heading with hairline-free thin strokes. Alumni Sans SC then packs its oversized lowercase tight, so a long paragraph feels compressed and contemporary.
gen-eater-gf-anaheim: Anaheim is rounded and open to the side, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Anaheim also gives the pair its sharpest quality: a dark, wide-gapped heading sitting over a dense, easygoing body.
gen-eater-gf-arsenal: Wide gaps between letters give Eater its menace, with short ascenders and hairline-free thin strokes. And Arsenal answers with a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, knit close and only slightly shifting in weight.
gen-eater-gf-arsenal-sc: Eater arrives dark and aggressive, its letters spaced wide apart with short ascenders. And Arsenal SC tucks its characters close, with a faint thick-thin shift and generous mouths that settle the page.
gen-eater-gf-asimovian: Mild contrast and wide gaps make Eater look dark without ever turning stark. And Asimovian traces every tall lowercase letter in one constant line, so bumping its size up a notch gives it presence.
gen-eater-gf-basic: Basic reads clean and businesslike, with only a gentle bump from small letters to capitals. Eater supplies the pair's strongest quality, a dark, wide-spaced heading with a mellow swing in its strokes.
gen-eater-gf-cal-sans: Eater brings dark menace, its moderate line variation and short ascenders spaced out wide. Cal Sans counters with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, a tall x-height, and an approachable steadiness.
gen-eater-gf-carlito: Carlito is tight-spaced, like thread on a spool, with open round letters. Eater supplies the pair's strongest quality: a brooding, wide-gapped heading against a body of big lowercase and small capitals.
gen-eater-gf-changa: Changa reads sturdy, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals. Over a longer stretch that weight stays clean and modern, while Eater's mild stroke swelling keeps the heading dark.
